checks.name: Invoice Number Format Validation
checks.description: Validates that the invoice number matches the expected alphanumeric pattern (3–20 characters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens, and slashes only).

checks.name: Duplicate Invoice Detection
checks.description: Detects exact and near-duplicate invoices within a 365-day rolling window. Near-duplicate scoring is a weighted blend of invoice number similarity (40%), line-item description similarity (40%), and amount similarity (20%). Threshold: 0.95.

category_b_gst.description: GST compliance checks — GSTIN format and tax split validation

checks.name: GSTIN Format Validation
checks.description: Validates the 15-character GSTIN against the Indian GST regex. Skipped for non-India vendors. Flags lowercase GSTINs for human escalation (possible OCR error). Non-India vendors auto-pass with a NON_INDIA_VENDOR flag.

checks.name: GST Tax Split Validation
checks.description: Enforces mutual exclusivity of intra-state (CGST + SGST, where CGST == SGST ± 0.01) and inter-state (IGST only) tax structures. Zero-tax invoices pass. Any mixed or invalid structure fails.

category_c_arithmetic.description: Arithmetic correctness checks — line items and totals

checks.name: Line Item Arithmetic Check
checks.description: For each line item, verifies that quantity × rate equals the declared amount within a ₹1 tolerance. Fails on the first mismatched line item.

checks.name: Subtotal and Grand Total Check
checks.description: Verifies that the sum of all line-item amounts matches the declared subtotal (±₹1), and that subtotal + total_tax equals the grand total (±₹1).

checks.name: TDS Applicability Engine
checks.description: Multi-signal vendor classification engine. Resolves vendor from registry using GSTIN/PAN (domestic) or tax_id/legal_name (foreign). Validates vendor status (SUSPENDED/CANCELLED → FAIL). Applies Section 195 for foreign vendors. Checks LDC (lower deduction certificate) validity and 206AB penalty flag. Returns structured TDS decision with rate, section, flags, and confidence.

checks.name: TDS Section Classification
checks.description: Keyword-frequency scoring over invoice description and line-item text to determine the most likely TDS section (194C, 194J, 194H, 194I, 194R, 194S). Returns best section, confidence, matched evidence keywords, and all section scores. Passes with NO_TDS_SIGNAL flag when no keywords match.

category_e_policy.description: Company policy compliance — PO tolerance and vendor approval

checks.name: Purchase Order Tolerance Check
checks.description: Compares invoice total against the linked PO amount. Fails if the deviation exceeds 5%. Skipped (SKIP, score 0/0) when no PO number or amount is present on the invoice.

checks.name: Approved Vendor Registry Check
checks.description: Looks up the vendor GSTIN against the approved vendor registry. Fails if the vendor is not found in the registry. Uses the same registry structure as D1.

decision_thresholds.HOLD_FOR_VERIFICATION: Any check reason contains 'unknown', 'not found', 'missing', 'unclear', or 'unresolvable'
decision_thresholds.REJECTED: One or more checks have status FAIL (and no HOLD condition)
